learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: 83 products in the Wix Stores category 'POT and HEAD' on Veterans Choice Creations' site (potandhead.com redirects there). NY-only processor in Gloversville.
notes: A Wix Stores gallery: the page embeds <script id=wix-warmup-data>, and appsWarmupData['1380b703-ce81-ff05-f115-39571d94dfcd'] (the Wix Stores app) holds the category's productsWithMetaData under a key that names the page ('initialData_default_TPASection_m02t1907_page=8'), hence the '*'. ?page=N renders items 1..N*20 at once: page 8 covers 160, and the category had 83 (totalCount). Raise it if totalCount passes 160. Prices are all 0 (catalog only).

Names are '<SIZE> | <LINE> | <STRAIN>' in capitals, so title_case is on. Not quite consistent: '1G  NON INFUSED PRE-ROLL | VANILLA KUSH' lacks a pipe, 'PRE- ROLL', 'NON INFUSED' vs 'NON-INFUSED', some flower skips the line ('28G | GELATO 41'), and '14G | TUXEDO | FLOWER | GARLIC BUTTER' has an extra segment. One urlPart contradicts its name (pot-head-tuxedo-zello-28g is '14G | TUXEDO | ZELLO'); the name is used.

The option keys (FLOWERS, PRE-ROLLS, CONCENTRATES, VAPE, FUEL TANKS) are the site's filters; one hash cube has none, and Fuel Tanks are filed under CONCENTRATES. A Fuel Tank is a 'portable dab vape', 'a 0.5g All-In-One' (its product page), and a Live Rosin Stone is an all-in-one (its urlPart says aio), so both are vaporizers. Format words in the name decide; FLOWERS decides only for flower names, which have none.
Plain pre-rolls ('NON-INFUSED PRE-ROLL', 'PRE ROLL') have no line; Tuxedo and Tuxedo Edition are separate flower lines (the site has an Animal Face in each).
The same site carries Veterans Choice Creations' other brands (New York Honey, Spacebuds, Mildly Moronic) under other categories; our listings attribute some New York Honey products to Pot & Head.
